posts.title: From a stale README to a security research intelligence platform
posts.description: A stale security-papers README grew into AI Scholar: a production system that ingests papers, deduplicates identities, extracts structured security-research records, maps the corpus as an atlas, and surfaces tensions between papers before I read them end to end.
